ploidyspec report: OncMaso1

Summary

Structure in this individual's assembly, read from the sections below; not inheritance and not origin. See docs/guide, Chapter 6.

Ploidy

2 haplotype copies of each of 33 chromosome numbers; no older duplicated sets detected.

Confidence: high. Evidence: copies from the assembly (2 per number)

Auto-like or allo-like?

Auto-like origin, mostly rediploidized: the duplicated sets have separated along most of their length, but 8 of 10 paired chromosome numbers keep stretches where the homeologs are as close as alleles (residual tetrasomy). That is expected after an autopolyploidization; recent homeologous exchanges in an allopolyploid can leave similar stretches.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: 10 chromosome numbers assessed: 10 split into lineages, 0 tetrasomic-like, 0 one divergent copy, 0 candidate; residual tetrasomy on 8/10 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers, 53.8 Mb, 62% of it terminal

TE markers

Only the absolute marker fraction is available (two copies per number); it does not separate diploid, auto- and allopolyploid, so no reading is made from it.

Confidence: not assessable. Evidence: te_marker_fraction mean 0.2029

Rediploidization

Partly: 8 of 10 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers keep stretches of residual tetrasomy (53.8 Mb, 62% of it at chromosome ends) where the homeologs are still as close as alleles; elsewhere they have diverged.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: residual tetrasomy on 8/10 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers, 53.8 Mb, 62% of it terminal; pair-depth CV 0.07

Copy number and copy divergence (whole-chromosome matrix)

Hierarchically reordered, chromosome-number resolution

Same distance data as the heatmaps above, but collapsed to one value per chromosome NUMBER (haplotype copies aggregated away) and reordered by average-linkage clustering -- shows cross-chromosome (subgenome/ancestral-pair) structure cleanly, including diffuse structure with no individually FDR-significant pair. Red outlines mark individually FDR-accepted pairs from the homeolog test below. See INTERPRETATION.md's "checkerboard" section.
